name: Bertrand
personality: A legendary warrior who fights endlessly for freedom, with a noble, virtuous heart under his overwhelming strength.
story: A white-haired Arago-born legend of Dagsion who killed Leda's father, which makes him the target of her revenge. Aswan knew him before the 1449 Heroic Games and is shocked to find him alive. He fights as a guest in Part II and joins fully in Part III.

personalSkill.name: Requiem Style
personalSkill.effect: 5% chance of a guaranteed follow-up regardless of AS. Lv20 adds Go No Sen (25% trigger); Lv35 adds Sen No Sen, active when he attacks first.

joins: Guest unit in Part II: War; full unit in Part III: Salvation. Requires completing his Part I paralogue.

build.role: Squad A sword duelist and Boon breaker
build.notes: Underworld-type Blaze Arts: four self Awakenings (Hit +50, Prt +10, Rsl +10, Avo +30) and Underworld Madness. Join class and level ?.

guide.role: Squad A duelist: sword striker who also wins enemy phase on a 25% Go No Sen
guide.summary: A sword duelist for squad A and the Lust gate (Cha 50). He carries the [[item:Cleansing Blade]] for Boon foes, so the axe and spear users beside him don't need Eshmel for the kill. Open a boss turn with Ruler's Awakening (Hit +50), then swing.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: Iron Sword +4 to double, Cleansing Blade on Boon foes; Blaze Blow for damage. Enemy phase: Go No Sen strikes first 25% of the time, Sen No Sen moves his follow-up before the counter. Keep mages off him (Res 20).
keys: Boss turn: Ruler's Awakening (Hit +50, gauge +1), then attack the same turn.
Train Sword A and Infantry C at the Arena (Infantry course) from Sec 2.
Take [[class:Sword Master]] on the S4 License once Mars's request clears.
Hold the Cleansing Blade for Boon foes; Iron Sword +4 everywhere else.
Sec 5: seat him on Cohen & Maria; Cha 50 growth wins Lust checks.
watch: Gauge: Underworld type. Each Awakening adds 1; Burst halves max HP. Count them.
Res: 20 growth. Gate mages two-shot him; Reason Awakening (Rsl +10) on mage turns.
Join class, level and ranks ?: Sword Master needs Sword A at Lv 45.
Lunging Gale (Sword A) and Instant Strike (Axe A): effects not in the data yet.
Weight: Iron Sword +4 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 6; Javelin +2 turns 10. Hexlock Shield adds 4: off on offense maps.

decisions.pick: Shido bridge, Sword Master from Sec 3
decisions.why: Sword Master adds Spd +7, Dex +7 flat and Spd +20 growth; Battlemaster gives Str +25 but Spd -5 and needs Gauntlet A (his arts stop at B). Simon already holds the Battlemaster line.
decisions.else: Battlemaster if Sword A stalls and Gauntlet A lands

decisions.pick: Cleansing Blade +3 on Boon foes, Wooden Sword +9 otherwise
decisions.why: Squad A's walls are spear users (Theodora, Ninae, Ultand): none strips the Boon. His sword does, so the squad can kill Boon foes outside Eshmel's 2 tiles.
The Blade (Sword S) is Loretta's and The Eternal is Tobias's (D-131): one holder each.
